<description>
Since #31375, Linux installs ship a bitcoin wrapper in bin/ that dispatches to multiprocess binaries in libexec/. Copying only bitcoind/bitcoin-qt leaves those stale. Tell users to copy over bin/ and libexec/ instead.

Fixes #36431.
</description>
